title: CWRU Bearing Data Center — Seeded Fault Local-Only Metadata
creator_or_provider: Case Western Reserve University Bearing Data Center
distributor: Case Western Reserve University Bearing Data Center; MotorPulse AI does not distribute source measurements
citation: Case Western Reserve University Bearing Data Center, official bearing test data pages; accessed locally by the user under applicable source terms.

license.original_or_derived_redistribution: unverified; local-only HOLD pending source-specific redistribution terms

collection.method: Third-party bearing test-rig experiments with normal conditions and single-point seeded faults created by EDM
collection.sample_rate_hz: explicit per local metadata: 12000 or documented drive-end 48000
collection.sample_count: read from the explicitly selected local MATLAB vector
collection.window_duration_s: derived from selected vector length divided by explicit sample rate
collection.actual_independent_runs: Do not infer independent run or asset identity from a MATLAB filename alone

labels.motor_fault: explicit seeded experiment condition only: normal, inner_race, ball or outer_race
labels.notes: CWRU fault records are seeded single-point EDM conditions, not run-to-failure trajectories or remaining-useful-life labels.

measurement_quality.missingness: Not inferred by the adapter; one explicitly named local vector is inspected
measurement_quality.outliers: No automatic physical-quality interpretation is assigned to summary statistics
measurement_quality.calibration: Value units remain unknown unless independently verified; MotorPulse does not convert native values to its synthetic g units

recommended_splits: Group related conditions by physical test identity when known. Never treat adjacent slices from one source vector as independent train/test assets; do not use seeded labels as run-to-failure or RUL truth.
intended_uses: Local inspection of user-supplied CWRU MATLAB-v5 bearing records with explicit metadata
Research on seeded-fault condition classification or feature behavior with source terms reviewed separately
Generating path-free summary provenance for reproducible local experiments
excluded_uses: Publishing original CWRU measurements or derived measurement tables through this repository before redistribution rights are verified
Inferring fault type, fault size, channel or test condition from filenames without explicit metadata
Treating seeded fault records as run-to-failure trajectories, failure times or RUL labels
Claiming transfer to MotorPulse synthetic faults or real industrial predictive-maintenance performance
known_limitations: The adapter supports only a bounded MATLAB-v5 real-double vector subset, not arbitrary MAT structures
Redistribution rights for original or derived CWRU measurements were not established from the official pages reviewed
MotorPulse does not bundle, download or validate the upstream measurement files
Physical units, independent-run grouping and downstream label semantics require explicit user review

rights_review.notes: Official pages provide public download links and experiment metadata, but this project review did not establish an explicit dataset redistribution license.
